source_evidence: Reject the64-significand hypothesis. texture_span_step now represents reciprocal and product as explicit integer significand/exponent pairs, truncating each to24bits; FILD delta remains exact, and65536 scaling is a power-of-two exponent adjustment. Active control selects_PC_24 plus_RC_CHOP; entry/exit remain FNINIT-equivalent PC64 resets.

At width1 and deltaINT_MAX, original24-bit arithmetic truncates to2147483520, not2147483647. Corrected independent oracle and actual-body regression controls must cover this distinction before a fresh native checkpoint. This resolution corrects the interpretation only, not full function/game acceptance or the retained local-scratch/exceptional-input/producer obligations.
